name: 香氛留香蓬松洗发露款
description: 香氛留香洗发露套图模版，雾蓝清新视觉，泵瓶白瓶薄荷青标

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and macro, misty blue-grey #EAF0F6 and pale blue #F1F5F9 for infographic shots, light stone marble for scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright airy studio lighting, soft top-front key, gentle water-like highlights, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: light grey-veined marble counter and matte pale-blue board
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline in indigo #3D5185
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and hexagon outline labels in single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and upright bottle scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh fragrance haircare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, misty blue-grey #EAF0F6, indigo text #3D5185 and one mint-teal accent #9CCFC6; bright airy studio lighting with soft top-front key and gentle water-like highlights; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end haircare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and upright bottle scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, pump bottle standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front key with gentle fill
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pump bottle standing upright, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front key and gentle fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the bottle. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 8K, commercial haircare e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no recognizable face, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达香氛留香的核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, bottle left of center
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, airy highlights, soft contact shadow
shots.background: misty blue-grey #EAF0F6 with a soft water sheen
shots.whitespace: clean top band reserved for the headline, side margin on the right about 30% for copy
shots.textZone: top 20% headline band reading 「{selling_point_1}」 and three short check labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 below it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle at a slight 3/4 hero angle left of center, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Background misty blue-grey #EAF0F6 with a soft water sheen, soft front-left key light, airy highlights and a soft contact shadow. A clean top band carries the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in indigo #3D5185 with three short check labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」, leaving the right side about 30% open as breathing space. Negative: no more than one core claim, no invented efficacy data, no dense body text, no recognizable face, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大头发油腻扁塌贴头皮的尴尬，引出清洁诉求
shots.camera: matched split-screen, both panels photographed straight-on with identical framing
shots.lighting: left panel flat and dull, right panel bright and airy
shots.whitespace: none, the two states fill the split
shots.textZone: a narrow top band with one short headline 「{callout_4}」 centered
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on framing and lighting logic. Left panel: a tight crop of limp, oily-looking hair strands lying flat under flat dull light, conveying heaviness without showing any face. Right panel: {product} in bright airy light with a hint of fresh foam, conveying a clean reset. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background pale blue #F1F5F9 on both panels, a narrow top band carries one short headline 「{callout_4}」. The product and hair subject occupy 45-55% per panel with no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable face or model identity, no fabricated before-after medical claims, no dandruff flakes rendered in graphic detail, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入居家洗护的真实场景，营造清爽SPA氛围
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level, candid handheld feel over a bathroom counter
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle steam, soft contact shadow
shots.background: light grey-veined marble bathroom counter #E8E3DC with soft steam
shots.props: a folded towel, a small wooden tray and a bar of unscented soap, none covering the product
shots.whitespace: none, scene context is the co-star
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} resting on a light grey-veined marble bathroom counter #E8E3DC with gentle morning steam. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle steam, soft contact shadow. Props: a folded towel, a small wooden tray and a bar of unscented soap, none covering the product. A person appears only as bare shoulders and wet hair from behind, never the face. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable face, no hands covering the product, no cluttered counter, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 用细腻绵密的泡沫质感证明温和亲肤的洗感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing fine foam texture, controlled highlight
shots.background: white foam field #FFFFFF with a mint-teal tinted edge #9CCFC6
shots.whitespace: minimal, the foam detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of dense creamy foam lathered from {product}, tight zoom on the foam surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Skimming side light from the right revealing fine foam texture with a controlled highlight. Background a white foam field #FFFFFF with a mint-teal tinted edge #9CCFC6. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking soap slime, no oversized bubbles, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands.

shots.intent: 用前中后三段香型结构讲清留香逻辑，建立专业感
shots.camera: flat lay, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: three hexagon outline labels, thin-line botanical icons and one small bottle silhouette per column
shots.whitespace: even margins between the three columns, about 15% outer margin for copy
shots.textZone: three hexagon labels reading 「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」 over three vertical columns, plus one short headline 「{selling_point_2}」 at the top
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three vertical columns with thin-line botanical icons and one small bottle silhouette each, hexagon outline labels reading 「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」 and one short headline 「{selling_point_2}」 at the top in indigo #3D5185. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background misty blue-grey #EAF0F6 matte board. The product elements occupy 50-60% of the frame with even margins as whitespace. shots.lighting: bright even studio light with soft contact shadows, consistent across both bottles
shots.background: white marble surface #F3F1EC with soft leaf shadows
shots.props: a sprig of dried botanicals in a corner, not covering the products
shots.textZone: one short label 「{callout_8}」 near the pair

Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down over the pair, consistent hero styling and identical lighting across both bottles. Bright even studio light with soft contact shadows. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. shots.intent: 以留白的资质位与参数行降低决策风险，不编造任何背书
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle centered with symmetric layout
shots.props: one empty circular seal frame, two blank label rows and one empty spec-line table as unfilled proof placeholders
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 35% reserved for trust copy
shots.textZone: left 35% zone with one short headline 「{selling_point_3}」 and two blank label rows left unfilled
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle straight-on eye-level and centered, occupying 50-60%. Even clean high-key studio light. Background pale blue #F1F5F9. Proof areas are deliberately unfilled placeholders: one empty circular seal frame, two blank label rows and one empty spec-line table, with one short headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in the left 35% negative space reserved for copy. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, test data, ingredient percentages or standards numbers, keep all seal frames empty, no dense text, no watermark, no fake logo, no QR code.

shots.intent: 深色收口促单，聚焦行动按钮与组合利益
shots.camera: slight 3/4 view with the camera tilted gently upward toward the bottle for presence
shots.lighting: punchy soft studio light with a rim highlight separating the bottle from the dark field
shots.props: one rounded CTA button shape and a thin mint-teal #9CCFC6 underline
shots.whitespace: bottom 25% reserved for the CTA band
shots.textZone: bottom band with a short headline 「{selling_point_4}」 and a CTA button reading 「{callout_9}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle at a slight 3/4 view with the camera tilted gently upward toward it for presence, occupying 55-60%. Punchy soft studio light with a rim highlight separating the bottle from the dark field. Background a deep indigo #3D5185 gradient field with a thin mint-teal #9CCFC6 underline and one rounded CTA button shape. The bottom 25% is reserved as whitespace for a short headline 「{selling_point_4}」 and a CTA button reading 「{callout_9}」. Negative: no invented discount numbers or countdowns, no fabricated claims, no garbled button text, no watermark, no fake logo, no QR code, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：panel-01 双泵瓶白瓶薄荷青标，功效勾选条（温和清洁/控油祛屑/顺滑滋养）与容量角标；panel-02 前中后调香型三栏信息图；panel-03 圆形放大镜成分图文与数字序号；panel-04 实验器皿萃取图加水面圆窗内睡颜模特；panel-05 泡沫与发丝双格图加产品信息表（品名含洗发乳字样、使用方法为搓洗出泡沫后冲洗，规格与有效期数值不写入）；panel-06 长发模特加四重养护气泡卖点与数字序号；panel-07/08 大理石面多角度实拍；panel-09 浴室巾架场景加会员二维码角标。品类判定：信息表品名为洗发乳、使用部位为头发与头皮、使用方法为搓洗头发，硬证据指向洗护发而非身体清洁或面部护理，故判 护肤个护/洗护发/香氛留香洗发露。已剥离：品牌字标与系列名、模特面容（统一改为背影、颈部以下或发丝特写）、原文案原句、容量与有效期等规格数值、成分名与含量、全部功效断言与序号卖点、会员二维码角标；功效与香型卖点一律以 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 留白占位。源页自相矛盾处：不同屏的功效说法不一致（清洁控油类与修护留香类并列且序号卖点各屏不同），两种口径均未作为事实写入。
